name: Filandia (Colombia)
description: Yellow field with a blue triangle from the hoist reaching the fly, bearing a red Phrygian cap.
history: Municipal flag of Filandia, a municipality in the department of Quindío, Colombia; Spanish Wikipedia records it as devised by Santiago López Sánchez in 1966, the yellow for work, the blue for peace and the Phrygian cap for liberty.

features.role: triangle from the hoist reaching the fly
